main.description: A team of an organization, at the record key equal to the team's name. Its members are commitments to private entries of the organization's members, as in 'dev.zena-lang.org.members', each a 'member' or 'maintainer' of the team. A change counts once the team's 'threshold' of maintainers, or the 'ownerThreshold' of the organization's scope's owners, have attested it.

threshold.description: How many of the team's maintainers, or the organization's admins, must attest a change to this record.
